name: tsuppari-visual-gate-07c
status: Visual Gate candidate (ACTION-07C). Not an accepted Product art contract: the User Visual Gate chooses the final Tsuppari art strategy.
note: Two authored red Tsuppari poses are the only runtime sources. Each is normalized like the accepted idle red (one whole-sprite rotation so FRONT = local +X, explicit root, body core = 2R, exact /4 downscale). Blue variants reuse the accepted red -> blue rule of runtime_wrestler_recipe.json (single owner): local-Y reflection ((x, y) -> (x, H - y)) swaps the wrestler's hand, the mawashi-only recolor keeps it. The authored blue candidates are normalized only for reference sheets and never become runtime textures.

measurement.method: The pose body is registered to the accepted idle red master (runtime_wrestler_recipe.json) with two torso landmarks measured on the source at 1/2 scale: H = hair blob centroid (dark opaque pixels, 7 px erosion drops outlines, largest component), B = mawashi centroid (hue-band pixels of every component >= 5% of the largest). rotation delta = angle(H -> B) - idle angle(H -> B); scale s = mean(sqrt(hair area ratio), sqrt(mawashi area ratio)); the idle root and body-core points are carried by s * Rot(delta) about the H/B midpoint. source_front_deg = idle 160.7 + delta. Blue references are measured against the screen-mirrored idle red (front 19.3, x -> 1254 - x). Values rounded: front 0.1 deg, points 1 px.

red_left.hand_evidence: Faces image left like the idle master; the extended arm is the screen-lower one = the wrestler's LEFT (-Y after normalization).

red_right.hand_evidence: Faces image left like the idle master; the extended arm is the screen-upper one = the wrestler's RIGHT (+Y after normalization).

measurement_evidence.remeasured: ACTION-07C1: User replacement (more forward strike). Same method; hair blob taken as the 7 px opening (erosion + dilation) of max(RGB) < 80, alpha > 200 at 1/2 BOX scale, with the idle reference re-measured the same way (hair (428.7, 542.7), 42652 px). Calibration on the replaced 07C pose: delta -0.617 / s 1.0093 / front 160.1 / root (768, 641) / core (637, 281)-(854, 880).

blue_left.hand_evidence: Faces image right; the extended arm is the screen-upper one = the wrestler's LEFT.

blue_right.hand_evidence: Faces image right; the extended arm is the screen-lower one = the wrestler's RIGHT.

mask_limits.note: Per-pose validation of the accepted hue-band + largest-component mawashi mask at runtime scale (fail closed). missed = band pixels outside the largest component.
